title: OTHRYS OS Housekeeping Optimization / Multichannel Study
objective: Turn around and optimize current OTHRYS OS residents through measurement, stress and bounded multiplicity, admitting parallelism only where independent work can increase verified throughput without sharing authority.
problem: Current residents are stable but multiplicity, routing cost and duplicate-work economics have not been qualified as one measured housekeeping pass.
outOfScope: No new scheduler or authority plane
risks: parallelism creates contention instead of throughput
Hephaestus hands collide in one workspace
laws: Verified useful throughput, not utilization, is the optimization target.
Mycelium may plan placements but Talos owns leases/lifecycle and Trust Canal owns authority.
Parallel mutation of the same path set is forbidden.
Multiplicity is bounded and must remain safe when reduced back to one channel.

slices.title: Routing efficiency and bounded multichannel planning

tasks.title: Optimize single route and qualify bounded placement planning
Run stress, failure and cross-node verification
